subject: MorphOS TaskList PID_CLI attribute and FindTaskByPID identity boundary

facts: TASKINFOTYPE_PID_CLI (0x24) reports a CLI number for a Process with a CLI and the unique task ID otherwise.
TASKINFOTYPE_PID (0x33) reports the unique ID assigned to each task.
FindTaskByPID accepts a unique process ID or CLI number; zero selects the current task. Reading a foreign task requires Forbid/Permit protection.
A CLI-number lookup may identify a replacement Process after the old CLI terminates and another takes its CLI number.

officialSdkLayoutEvidence.package: MorphOS SDK May 2026, local package sdk-20260529.lha

layout.uniqueIdOffsetDerivation: ETask.Message is 20 bytes and ETask.Parent is one 4-byte pointer before UniqueID.

officialSdkLayoutEvidence.interpretation: For MorphOS-shaped tasks with a mapped ETask extension, the provider reads the same unique ID described by TASKINFOTYPE_PID and TASKINFOTYPE_PID_CLI. NewCreateTaskA allocates this extension in its existing owned task block. DOS-owned Process allocation also creates it when the Exec library version is 50 or newer; version 40 retains the original Workbench Process and stack layout. Both paths assign a nonzero ID from ExecBase.ex_TaskID under Forbid/Permit. This does not prove that other standard Exec paths create extensions or that assigned values match a MorphOS guest.

candidateImplementation.cliProcessBehavior: For an NT_PROCESS task with a non-null Process.pr_CLI, return Process.pr_TaskNum.
candidateImplementation.nonCliBehavior: Read ETask.UniqueID only when TF_ETASK marks tc_ETask valid and the extension is mapped; otherwise retain the portable task-address identity fallback.
candidateImplementation.findTaskByPidBehavior: Search live current, ready, and waiting tasks by MorphOS ETask.UniqueID when present, otherwise the portable task-address fallback, or the current CLI number. A CLI number can resolve to a replacement Process after the old task is removed and the number is reused.
candidateImplementation.newCreateTaskBehavior: Allocate an 86-byte ETask after the task body in the existing owned allocation, initialize its Message and Children list, assign a nonzero value from ExecBase.ex_TaskID while task switches are forbidden, and let the existing reap path release it with the task.
candidateImplementation.dosOwnedProcessBehavior: When the Exec library version is 50 or newer, append an 86-byte ETask after Process and before the stack, publish tc_ETask, initialize its parent and child list, and assign a nonzero ex_TaskID under Forbid/Permit. Exec version 40 keeps the classic Process and stack layout.

checks: MC68000 and managed traces agree when reading a valid ETask unique ID
